meta.contamination_policy: Few-shot exemplars in train_fewshot.json are chosen from topics that never appear in test_heldout.json. The two splits share no sample ids and reference disjoint knowledge base documents, preventing test-set contamination.

categories.normal: Direct, single-hop factual questions answerable from a single knowledge base document.
categories.edge_case: Adversarial or boundary cases: ambiguous phrasing, out-of-scope topics, multi-hop reasoning, arithmetic, contradicting claims, and threshold rules.

knowledge_base.title: Company overview
knowledge_base.content: AcmeCorp is a software company founded in 2012 and headquartered in Berlin, Germany. It employs roughly 340 people across engineering, product, sales, and support teams.

knowledge_base.title: Vacation policy
knowledge_base.content: Full-time employees receive 22 business days of paid vacation per calendar year. Vacation accrues at a rate of 1.83 days per month (22 / 12). Carry-over of unused days to the next year is capped at 5 days. Vacation must be approved by the manager at least two weeks in advance.

knowledge_base.title: Remote work policy
knowledge_base.content: Employees may work remotely up to 2 days per week with manager approval. Remote days must still overlap with core hours (10:00-16:00) and employees must be reachable during that window.

knowledge_base.title: Health insurance and wellness stipend
knowledge_base.content: The company covers 80% of each employee's health insurance premium; employees pay the remaining 20%. In addition, a wellness stipend of $500 per year is provided for fitness classes, wellness apps, and similar expenses, paid quarterly.

knowledge_base.title: Expense reimbursement policy
knowledge_base.content: Business expenses are reimbursed within 5 business days after approval. A receipt must be attached for any single expense above $25. Expenses must be approved by the direct manager.

knowledge_base.title: Travel policy
knowledge_base.content: Ground transportation (taxi, ride-hailing) for business trips is reimbursable; keep the receipt because trips usually exceed $25. Flights: economy class on flights under 6 hours; business class only on transoceanic flights longer than 8 hours. Hotels are covered up to $180 per night.

knowledge_base.title: IT and security policy
knowledge_base.content: The IT helpdesk resolves password reset requests within 1 hour. A VPN must be used whenever working from a public or untrusted Wi-Fi network. All employees complete quarterly phishing awareness training and must report lost or stolen devices to IT immediately.

knowledge_base.title: Parental leave policy
knowledge_base.content: Parents may take 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave after completing 6 months of tenure. The leave can be split between both parents.

knowledge_base.title: Sick leave policy
knowledge_base.content: For sick leave of up to 3 days no medical certificate is required. Absences of 4 or more consecutive days require a doctor's note.

knowledge_base.title: Unpaid leave policy
knowledge_base.content: Employees may take up to 4 weeks of unpaid leave per calendar year, after paid leave entitlements are exhausted. Requests must be approved by the manager.

knowledge_base.title: Education budget
knowledge_base.content: Employees receive an annual education and development budget of $1,000, usable for courses, books, and certifications.

knowledge_base.title: Data retention policy
knowledge_base.content: AcmeCorp retains personal data for 24 months, after which it is automatically deleted, unless legal retention requirements override this limit.

samples.question: If one parent takes one third of the parental leave, how many weeks remain for the other parent?
samples.expected_answer: Approximately 10.7 weeks remain: 16 - (16 / 3) = 16 - 5.33 = 10.67. When the result is fractional, report it as approximately 10.7; do not round to a whole number.
